name: Iguatemi S.A.
summary: Iguatemi S.A., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the commercial exploration and planning of shopping centers in Brazil. The company is also involved in the purchase of parking lots, and sale of real estate. In addition, it provides economic, financial and tax advisory, and consultancy services. The company was formerly known as Jereissati Participações S.A. and changed its name to Iguatemi S.A. in November 2021. Iguatemi S.A. was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in São Paulo, Brazil.
